conceded_f3_entries_by_channel.sentence: Share of final-third entry passes conceded, by lateral third (defending team's frame): defending team's left = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the opponent's attacking third and ending in the opponent's attacking third, end location in the opponent's right lateral third; centre = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the opponent's attacking third and ending in the opponent's attacking third, end location in the central lateral third; defending team's right = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the opponent's attacking third and ending in the opponent's attacking third, end location in the opponent's left lateral third. Each part is a share of the three-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.

conceded_f3_entries_wide_share.sentence: Share of final-third entry passes conceded in the two outer lateral thirds: wide (both outer lateral thirds) = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the opponent's attacking third and ending in the opponent's attacking third, end location in the opponent's left lateral third plus completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the opponent's attacking third and ending in the opponent's attacking third, end location in the opponent's right lateral third; centre = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the opponent's attacking third and ending in the opponent's attacking third, end location in the central lateral third. Each part is a share of the two-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.

conceded_box_entries_by_origin_channel.sentence: Share of penalty-area entry passes conceded, by lateral third of origin (defending team's frame): defending team's left = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the penalty-area rectangle at the opponent's attacking end and ending in the penalty-area rectangle at the opponent's attacking end, start location in the opponent's right lateral third; centre = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the penalty-area rectangle at the opponent's attacking end and ending in the penalty-area rectangle at the opponent's attacking end, start location in the central lateral third; defending team's right = completed open-play passes by the opponent starting outside the penalty-area rectangle at the opponent's attacking end and ending in the penalty-area rectangle at the opponent's attacking end, start location in the opponent's left lateral third. Each part is a share of the three-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.

conceded_shots_inside_box_share.sentence: Share of conceded shots not taken directly from a set piece that start inside the penalty-area rectangle: inside the rectangle = shots not taken directly from a set piece by the opponent, start location inside the penalty-area rectangle at the opponent's attacking end; outside it = shots not taken directly from a set piece by the opponent, start location outside that rectangle. Each part is a share of the two-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.

defensive_actions_by_pitch_third.sentence: Share of recorded defensive actions by pitch third (team's own frame): own third = recorded defensive actions (ground defending duel records, interception-tagged events and fouls recorded as Foul; each event once) by the team, start location in the team's own third; middle third = recorded defensive actions (ground defending duel records, interception-tagged events and fouls recorded as Foul; each event once) by the team, start location in the middle third; attacking third = recorded defensive actions (ground defending duel records, interception-tagged events and fouls recorded as Foul; each event once) by the team, start location in the team's attacking third. Each part is a share of the three-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.

high_zone_defensive_action_share.sentence: High-zone defensive actions as a share of those actions plus opponent pass attempts in the opponent's own 60%: high-zone defensive actions = recorded defensive actions (ground defending duel records, interception-tagged events and fouls recorded as Foul; each event once) by the team starting in the zone at least 40% of the pitch length from the team's own goal line; opponent pass attempts in its own 60% = open-play pass attempts by the opponent starting in the opponent's own 60% of the pitch length. Each part is a share of the two-part total. Window: first and second half, both teams at eleven, goal difference at most one.
